text:
Which statement about a magnet is not correct?
A
It can attract another magnet.
B
It can attract an unmagnetised piece of iron.
C
It can repel another magnet.
D
It can repel an unmagnetised piece of iron.

options.label: B
options.text: It can attract an unmagnetised piece of iron.

options.label: D
options.text: It can repel an unmagnetised piece of iron.
